title: Payment API HTTP 500
description: Payment requests failed with HTTP 500 when transaction_id was missing.
root_cause: Database insertion failed because transaction_id was NULL.
resolution: Generate transaction_id before creating the payment record.
evidence: DatabaseError: Cannot insert NULL into column transaction_id

title: Payment API Timeout
description: Payment requests experienced database timeout errors.
resolution: Increase connection pool capacity and investigate long-running queries.

title: Payment API HTTP 400
description: Payment requests were rejected because currency was missing.
root_cause: Request validation failed because currency is required.
resolution: Validate required payment fields before calling the payment service.
